rules.reason: Local colleague state is private and non-portable.
Local demo databases, receipts, and logs are not public fixtures.
Raw research evidence may contain private or acceptance data.
Internal operator and live-acceptance procedures require clean public rewriting.
Internal agent skills and persistent state are outside the public product.
Framework and vendor spikes are not supported product code.
Research evaluation machinery and personal ratings are not v0.1 product scope.
Scenario harnesses require separate synthetic-fixture review.
Private milestone evidence collectors are not public product tools.
Private milestone attestations cannot become public release claims.
Generated artifacts require per-file public review.
